thesis: The morning thesis is intact but the trade is not live: the 11/5 earnings gap holds after a Q3 beat (revenue +27%, net income +36% YoY), the last price of 63.50 is above SMA20 60.63, SMA50 56.89 and SMA200 45.20, and today's low of 63.22 stayed above both the 11/16 low of 61.75 and the morning zone (62.0-63.0), so the zone did not fill. This downgrade from Overweight is about the trade math, not a broken thesis. The pre-close technical card resets the levels to stop 55.8 (below the 10-day swing low of 56.01) and target 71.3 (measured move 61.77 + (67.40 - 57.88)), replacing the morning's 57.7/72.0, which was not traceable to a packet level. With those levels, R/R is about 1.0 at the last price of 63.50 and 1.26 at the card's mid-zone, below 1.5. With the risk-off regime (QQQ below its 50/200-day, VIX at the 0.877 percentile) and beta 1.6, that is too thin for a new position. Upgrade case: a pullback to 61.8-62.0 that holds above SMA20 (R/R 1.50-1.58), or a close above 67.40 on volume.
invalidation: A daily close below 55.8 (under the 56.01 swing low), or a close below the SMA20 (~60.6) on rising volume that fails to reclaim it, which would turn the earnings gap into a failed breakout.
key_risks: Risk-off regime (QQQ below 50/200-day, XLK ret_21 -10.2%) with beta 1.6 and 11.5% of float short, so drawdowns are amplified
Target 71.3 requires a breakout above the 67.40 52-week high; the 11/16 rejection from 66.54 to 61.75 shows supply there
Wide ATR (3.37, 5.3% of price): the stop at 55.8 is 7.7 below the last price
8-K Item 5.02 brand-leader retirement; the filing text is unread
Debt of about 476M vs cash of about 417M
The packet news is about half GCT Semiconductor (GCTS) items, a different company; these were excluded, so the GigaCloud-specific news flow is thinner than it looks
